title: Figure 24. A single molecule DNA-based nanomotor driven by photons (azobenzene)
description: Schematic of a DNA sequence with a 5' FAM fluorophore (orange sphere) and a 3' Dabcyl quencher (purple sphere), with bracketed segments labeled "5' Stem," "Loop," and "3' Stem."
